linear_psnr_note: SVGF and SVGF plus TAA demodulate by albedo + 1e-3 like v1, so near-black specular pixels produce very large linear values; linear PSNR with a 99.9th-percentile peak then punishes them hard (raw_hero SVGF -6.3 dB). Tone-mapped PSNR and FLIP are the readable comparisons here.
